sbh1.1:1.2: The MS begins here, mid-list (Shukla p. 5 n. 1); the opening of the gotrabhūmi survives in Xuanzang (T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.1:1.3: *manuṣyatva* is kept in Sanskrit (see the glossary); the text defines it at 1.4–5 as rebirth among humans with the male faculty.
sbh1.1:1.10: Printed *ajāto*; read *ajaḍo* ‘not dull’ (Xuanzang 不愚鈍, T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.1:1.30: Printed *evam evā [ ] [kleśa ā yā] ta evaṁ*, illegible and broken (Shukla p. 7 nn. 4–5), and the close *[ayam ucyate buddhānām utpādaḥ]* is Shukla's supplement; the segment defines *saddharmadeśanā* and the sense follows Xuanzang 云何名為說正法教…名正法教 (T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.1:1.33: Printed *yāva [ ] [vasthānaṁ veditavyaṁ]*, MS broken (Shukla p. 8 n. 1); the sense follows Xuanzang 當知說彼勝義正法作證道理 (T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.1:3.5: Printed *kaḍa(la)travargaṁ*, with Shukla's correction; read *kalatravargaṁ* ‘wife and household’ (Xuanzang 妻子眷屬, T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.1:4.2: Printed *upasampatkuśalair aśīḥśīla-*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 受具足戒；或受勞策所學尸羅 (T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.1:8.3: Printed *sa divā*; read *rātryāḥ prathame yāme* ‘in the first watch of the night’ (Shukla p. 11 n. 1, reporting Wayman; Xuanzang 於初夜分, T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.1:11.12: Printed *evāla [ ] tṛṣṇā* (Shukla p. 16 n. 2) and *anutpādyā*; read *evālayatṛṣṇā* ‘craving for the *ālaya*’ and *anutpāṭyā* ‘not to be uprooted’ (Xuanzang 阿賴耶愛, 不可傾拔, T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.1:12.5: Gap in the printed text after *anekaparyāyeṇa* (Shukla p. 17 n. 2, MS leaf damaged); the sense follows Xuanzang 本性成就上品無慚無愧 (T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.1:12.8: Printed text breaks off after *nānyatra* (Shukla p. 17 n. 5, half the leaf lost); Xuanzang has 唯觀現法。由是因緣，自身財寶衰退過患 (T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.1:12.11: Printed *muktimātre*; read *adhimuktimātre* ‘even a mere conviction’ (Xuanzang 微小信解, T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.1:12.15: Printed *vā śikṣākāmasya*; read *vā ’śikṣākāmasya* ‘who does not desire the training’ (Xuanzang 非不樂學, T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.1:12.16: Printed text omits the predicate after *nairyāṇikato*; supplied from Xuanzang 本非出家，唯有任持出家相狀 (T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.1:19.2: Printed *nātyarthaṁ … atyarthaṁ dhandhavāhīni*; read *atyarthaṁ* ‘extremely’ (Xuanzang 極遲運轉, T1579 juan 21; cf. 20.2 *nātyarthaṁ*).
sbh1.1:21.7: Printed *tanu vā*, added by a separate hand and illegible (Shukla p. 21 n. 1); not rendered.
sbh1.1:24.2: Printed *pramattāmithyāpratipannānāvṛtā (pannā anāvṛtā) veditavyāḥ*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 如是一切如前應知。與此相違… (T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.1:25.10: Printed *sa bhavyo*; read *so ’bhavyo* ‘not fit’ (Xuanzang 不能, T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.1:25.12: Printed *prayoga kāladūratayā*; read *prayogadūratayā na kāladūratayā* (Xuanzang 不由時遠, T1579 juan 21).
sbh1.1:26.1: The MS breaks off after *āsanne pudgalaḥ* (Shukla p. 22 n. 2); the definitions of the near, matured, and purified persons survive in Xuanzang (T1579 juan 21).
